instruction: Buy me a coffee grinder on amazon with at least 4.5 seller rating that will fit in my kitchen countertop area of 6.3X6.3 (LxW) inches.
notes: Single-app purchase task. search_products is called with product_type 'coffee grinder' (plus the same query) and min_seller_rating 4.5 so results already satisfy the seller-rating constraint; show_product is the lookup that verifies the chosen candidate's length and width are both <= 6.3 inches (the 'verified-fits' knowledge predicate stands for this runtime check, which the agent performs by inspecting the product details and picking a fitting one). clear_cart is required before add_product_to_cart so the resulting order contains exactly one product with quantity 1. Existing address and payment card ids are looked up (show_addresses / show_payment_cards) and used unchanged; no address is created, updated or deleted. complete_task takes no answer; its product/quantity parameters are task records only (not API arguments) so its precondition mirrors the goal.
